LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_ColonyLeader: Leads the whole colony under its current form of government.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_CouncilRepresentative: Speaks for a house on the colony council and votes on its behalf.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_Healer: The colony's healer: looks after people's health and holds check-ups.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_Teacher: The colony's teacher: holds lessons for the children.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_HallKeeper: Keeps the colony's hall and hosts its shared meals.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_Chaplain: Tends to the colony's spirits and comforts people in hard times.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_HouseHead: Speaks for the house and makes its decisions.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_PublicHeir: Named by the head of house as the one to lead next, and known to be.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_Steward: Trusted by the head of house to organise the house's affairs.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_HouseProtector: A trusted family member who watches over the house's people. (Not yet in the game.)
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_CeremonyOrganizer: Is arranging an occasion for the house, such as a wedding, a funeral or a reunion.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_TrustedAssociate: Not family, but a long-standing, trusted friend of the house.
LanguageData.WFL_RoleDesc_Associate: Not family, but known to the house and welcome there.
LanguageData.WFL_S_RoleIcons: Show family-role icons on the colonist bar
LanguageData.WFL_S_RoleIconsTip: A small emblem on each colonist's portrait for their most senior family role. Hover for details; click to open their family.
LanguageData.WFL_S_RoleIconsLeadership: Show only leadership and appointed roles
LanguageData.WFL_S_RoleIconsLeadershipTip: Hides trusted associates too. Turn off to show them.
LanguageData.WFL_S_AssociateIconsTip: People who are not family but have standing with a house. Many colonists can qualify, so this is off by default.
